title: HubHomeNeedsLink
responsibility: Takes a clicked notification to its ask's session chat, or to the needs-you list.

inputs.name: HubHomeNeedsLink.view
inputs.description: The Home view, read for the current open asks.

inputs.name: HubHomeNeedsLink.open
inputs.description: Opens a Home section; used for the asking session's chat.

inputs.name: HubHomeNeedsLink.close
inputs.description: Closes the open Home dialog before the list is shown.

inputs.name: HubHomeNeedsLink.reload
inputs.description: Reads Home again after a click reaches an open tab.

inputs.name: HubHomeNeedsLink.dialog
inputs.description: True while a Home dialog is open.

outputs.name: HubHomeNeedsLink
outputs.description: No markup; it only navigates and focuses.
